title: diphasiastrum yueshanense
intro: Diphasiastrum yueshanense, commonly known as Yueshan fir clubmass, is a type of lycopodiophyte, a group of vascular plants that belong to the division Lycopodiophyta. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antitumor activities. The therapeutic actions of Diphasiastrum yueshanense include its ability to inhibit cancer cell growth, reduce inflammation, and enhance immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various compounds such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
